g.text: hey. um. quincy talked to me yesterday. said you and he have been talking and that you... wanted to say some stuff?
I just... really wanted to apologize.
I think he was just messing with you, I don't know what you're talking about. [End.]
Yeah. I. I don't know how else to say this, but I - I have feelings for you.
i... ::sigh:: well, i mean... we are gonna be stuck here for a really long time, and i guess...
i know this is gonna come as a shock coming from me, but um... that really doesn't sound like something he'd do. but okay. whatever
i'd be lying if i said i didn't have feelings for you, so... um... heh... yeah... i... i forgive you
i... i mean, but... you had your chance... and... you walked away. you really want to give this another shot?
you know you could have just... come up and talked to me? or that you had like a doooozen different chances while we were talking, right?
do you really want to give this another shot?
...something tells me you would probably suck pretty hard at puzzle games...
so. you wanna do this? really?
